title: RailsDupeFix
description: Fixes rails dupe by preventing rail movement via pistons, making rails behave as immovable blocks.
body:
RailsDupeFix is a lightweight server-side Fabric mod that prevents rail duplication caused by piston interactions by making rails immovable.

It fixes a vanilla edge case where rails can be displaced or broken during piston block movement, which can be exploited for duplication glitches.
